Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale
At FLS we are committed to shaping the future of the mining industry. For over 140 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation, delivering full flowsheet technology and services that drive efficiency and sustainability.
 About the Role 
 The IT Onsite Specialist – GBC is a senior-level onsite IT role based at a Global Business Center (GBC), a strategically important hub that provides IT services to a regional cluster of sites. This role goes beyond traditional onsite support: the specialist serves a high-sensitivity client base including regional executives, senior leadership, and VIP stakeholders who demand premium, white-glove service delivery.
 In addition to direct service delivery at the GBC, this specialist provides remote operational oversight across multiple satellite sites within the same region, working alongside and guiding dedicated local technicians at those sites. For sites without a dedicated technician, the specialist directs and quality-controls third-party dispatch technicians, ensuring vendor-delivered support meets internal standards. While not a formal people manager, this role carries a strong leadership, coordination, and vendor oversight responsibility, ensuring regional consistency in service quality, process adherence, and technical standards.
 This is a 100% onsite position at the GBC facility. The specialist is the most senior IT presence on the ground and acts as the regional anchor for all IT support operations
 Key Responsibilities 
Provide advanced Level 2 onsite IT support, resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues through ServiceNow while ensuring SLA compliance.
Deliver high-touch, white-glove IT support to executives, senior leaders, and VIP stakeholders, with a strong focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and confidentiality.
Act as a regional technical point of contact, providing guidance and coaching to onsite technicians and coordinating support across multiple locations.
Coordinate third-party field technicians, including dispatch planning, technical briefings, work validation, and vendor performance monitoring.
Support workplace technologies, including Windows devices, mobile devices, Microsoft Teams Rooms, AV systems, and other end-user equipment.
Provide hands-on support for network and server infrastructure, including installations, diagnostics, cabling, and physical connectivity tasks.
Manage IT assets, inventory, equipment lifecycle, and employee onboarding and offboarding.
Support regional and global IT projects, site operations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Maintain accurate technical documentation and contribute to standardized IT processes and procedures.
 What You Bring 
At least 5 years of experience in IT support or a related technical role within a corporate or enterprise environment.
Demonstrated experience in executive-level or high-touch IT support.
Experience guiding or coaching technicians and supporting multi-site IT operations.
Strong hands-on knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, end-user devices, networking fundamentals, and workplace technologies.
Extensive experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform, as well as IT asset management.
Familiarity with endpoint management tools such as Intune, SCCM, or Jamf.
Experience coordinating third-party technicians or service providers is an advantage.
Fluent English and business-level proficiency in the local language.
Excellent communication, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with strong discretion, professionalism, and a customer-focused mindset.
 Preferred Certifications 
CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, or Microsoft 365 / Windows certifications are considered an advantage.
